newsitem.title: UK: BA saw passenger traffic rise in December.
newsitem.headline: BA saw passenger traffic rise in December.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Monday paying passenger traffic in December 1996 rose by 9.9 percent and capacity rose by 8.4 percent to give an overall load factor of 69.1 percent -- up 1.0 percentage points on the year-ago month.
Britain's largest airline said it had seen a rise in its all-important premium business and first class traffic of 6.0 percent in the month, while main cabin volume rose by 10.6 percent.

In the fourth quarter to the end of December, overall traffic growth of 9.1 percent and capacity growth of 8.4 percent meant BA's scheduled passenger load factor rose to a record 71.2, up from 70.7 percent the previous year.
Premium traffic grew by 5.9 percent in the quarter against 9.7 percent growth in the main cabin.
